source: hi can U make a dress up game where there is a VIP area and U must use robux to go in and it cost 221 robux and a free area for all players and can U make rankings and make a runway after 10 minutes to dress up

answers.ask: No look was stated - should this read as glossy pink fashion-show, or a sleeker modern catwalk?
answers.answer: Make it a glossy pink fashion-show style, since it is a dress-up game with a runway.

answers.ask: Is the VIP area a separate room you walk into, or a fenced-off part of the same open space? Going inside adds a slower build step.
answers.answer: Make the VIP area a fenced-off part of the same open space, with entry locked behind the 221 Robux purchase.

scene_prompt: Create a glossy pink fashion-show dress-up map with a shared open styling area for all players and a fenced-off VIP section within the same space. Place a prominent runway/catwalk as the central presentation area, with surrounding open floor space for dressing up.
blob:
### Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim, specifically a dress-up experience with a timed runway presentation. The Robux price, rankings, and timing are mechanics and do not alter the map geometry.

### Shape and preset
Use `stage-runway`, matching the Dress Up preset. Retain the shared social preparation character of that preset, but adapt it to the author’s single open fashion-show floor: the VIP section is not a separate interior or map.

### Config requirements
Use `social-hub` as the broad shared styling and gathering floor surrounding the catwalk. No other image configuration is required: the VIP area is defined by its visible fence and placement rather than an extra option.

### Layout requirements
No additional placed gameplay markers are required from the stated scene. Rankings, the VIP purchase check, and the ten-minute presentation cycle are script and UI decisions rather than layout placements.

### Layout components
Build one medium-sized enclosed fashion-show venue. A long, prominent central runway/catwalk runs through the middle as the presentation zone, with ample glossy pink open floor on both sides for all-player styling and gathering. Place a fenced VIP section along one side of the shared floor, visibly exclusive but still overlooking and connected visually to the runway; it remains within the same room rather than behind an exterior-to-interior transition. Use low decorative barriers and a clear entry gap at the VIP enclosure. Keep circulation open around both ends of the catwalk so players can reach the runway without crossing through the VIP section. The boundary is a single polished indoor venue perimeter, with no separate backstage, dressing booths, audience stands, or exterior space specified. Compose the frame symmetrically around the runway, with the pink styling floor and fenced VIP zone clearly readable at a glance.

### Render order
Use `isometric` first and treat it as authoritative, since the scene is a simple, readable single-room composition with no topology whose failure would make play impossible.

### Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Scale is medium, driven by one central runway plus a generous shared preparation floor and VIP enclosure. Theme: glossy pink fashion-show, polished catwalk glamour, bright feminine presentation lighting. Use `P0`: this is one single-level interior-like venue with no forced overhangs, transitions, separate maps, or procedural-valid route.
